# Vendored dependency

`pdf-lib.min.js` — pdf-lib 1.17.1 (UMD build, minified)

- Source: https://unpkg.com/pdf-lib@1.17.1/dist/pdf-lib.min.js
- Project: https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib
- License: MIT (© Andrew Dillon)

It is committed here on purpose. LocalPDF must work with **zero external
requests**, so the library is served from this folder instead of a CDN.
Upgrade by replacing the file and bumping the version above.
